## Description {#details}

<p>Whether or not the instruction has greater than or equal to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Size</span> immediate successors.</p>


<p>If <span class="doxyComputerOutput">HasIntermediary</span> is true, this tests also whether all successors of the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sunit">SUnit</a> have greater than or equal to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Size</span> successors.</p>
